definition: Sketch recognition describes the process by which a computer or artificial intelligence can interpret hand-drawn sketches, created by a human being or other machine.
details: Sketch recognition is a key frontier in the field of artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction, similar to natural language processing or conversational artificial intelligence.

explainer.lead: Sketch recognition is the process by which a computer or AI interprets hand-drawn sketches made by a human or another machine. It matters as a key frontier in AI and human-computer interaction, comparable to natural language processing or conversational AI.

tiers.eli5: It's a computer looking at your hand-drawn doodle and working out what you meant by it, much as a person would recognise a quick drawing of a house.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply sketch recognition wherever drawn input must be interpreted by a system, treating it as an interaction problem alongside language understanding. A pitfall is that freehand sketches are variable and ambiguous, so interpretation is inherently uncertain.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as the process by which a computer or artificial intelligence interprets hand-drawn sketches, whether created by a human being or another machine; it is framed as a key frontier of AI and human-computer interaction.

explainer.example: A user sketches a diagram on a tablet and the system interprets the drawn shapes as intended objects or commands.
